title: DBpedia explained: why linked data still matters
description: A practical reading of the 2007 DBpedia paper: RDF, stable entity identity, linked data, and what they mean for semantic storage and AI agents.
paperTitle: DBpedia: A Nucleus for a Web of Open Data

title: TransE explained: relationships beyond vector similarity
description: How TransE uses h + r ≈ t to learn knowledge graph embeddings, where its simple model breaks down, and why vectors still need explicit relationships.
paperTitle: Translating Embeddings for Modeling Multi-relational Data

title: RAG explained: external memory brings data governance back
description: Read the original RAG paper through a database engineer's lens: parametric memory, retrieval, RAG-Sequence, RAG-Token, and the limits of grounding.
paperTitle: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

title: Reflexion explained: agent memory without weight updates
description: How Reflexion turns feedback into agent memory, why the evaluator matters, and what its experiments do and do not establish about learning from failure.
paperTitle: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning

title: HippoRAG explained: why RAG comes back to knowledge graphs
description: How the original HippoRAG combines knowledge graphs and Personalized PageRank for retrieval across documents, with a close look at its limits.
paperTitle: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
